purpose: Lifecycle status for every render pass / pipeline family so future slices MOVE a pass one step forward instead of re-deciding from scratch whether it should be modeled. Source of truth for scripts/check-pass-coverage.py.

status_legend.UNREGISTERED: ad-hoc GL state; no PipelineDesc row. next = register (or recon).
status_legend.DESCRIPTIVE_REGISTERED: PipelineDesc row exists + checked, but NOT applied via applyPipeline (state still hand-set).
status_legend.VISUAL_PROVEN: routed AND a before/after pixel-identical (or perceptual) gate passed.
status_legend.SPIRV_ELIGIBLE: visual-proven AND the shader family is baked + selectable as offline SPIR-V.
status_legend.DO_NOT_MODEL: intentionally never a static PipelineDesc row (dynamic-state emulator, non-draw, or not-a-pass). REQUIRES reason.

Water.evidence: the GL water draw (renderWaterFastPath applyPipeline(WaterArmed)) was deleted in s62; the descriptor stays registered for the frame-graph model and the water is drawn by the Vulkan water island. Earlier proof: WATER-ARMED-APPLYPIPELINE-ROUTING-1: routed at gosRenderer::renderWaterFastPath (gameos_graphics.cpp:3275) via applyPipeline(WaterArmed). VISUAL_PROVEN via oracle_coverage (HARNESS-ISOLATION-1 session, 2026-06-23): hardened pipeline_visual_gate water profile on the routed build (v0.4c / 051946c3) captured bookmark mc2_01 water_overview_high (an entirely-water frame) 3-run BYTE-STABLE post-warmup sha cb5a700ebd00 (deterministic clock; both poses stable), and the [PIPELINE_BIND] draw-oracle recorded WaterArmed bound 19184x with the exact row state depth=GreaterEqual cull=None frontFace=Ccw polygonOffset=false. State byte-identical to the old hand-set (cull off, depth-test on, GEQUAL, blend SRC_ALPHA/1-SRC_ALPHA; no-op frontFace/offset) — confirmed by trace, not a pixel A/B. depthMask kept manual (debug-gated MC2_WATER_NO_DEPTH_WRITE). Build green; smoke PASS.
Water.scope_note: ONLY the armed fast-path base. The armed fast path is the DEFAULT render path (real latch terrain.cpp:2779, called unconditionally gamecam.cpp:530; gameosmain.cpp:852 MC2_RENDER_WATER_FASTPATH is only a diagnostic flag, NOT the gate). Legacy quad fallback + GPU-driven MDI sub-variant NOT modeled.
Water.proofNote: PROOF = oracle_coverage (LANDED), not byte_identical: a pixel before/after was deliberately NOT required. The pass is DETERMINISTIC (3-run byte-stable cb5a700ebd00), DRAWS (19184 [PIPELINE_BIND] WaterArmed binds = SAMPLES rasterized), and its bound state is trace-confirmed identical to the legacy hand-set GL state. Together (determinism + draw-oracle + state-identity) these establish the applyPipeline routing is a visual no-op without a separate BEFORE build. Harness made concurrent-safe by HARNESS-ISOLATION-1 (own-only child reap; never kills foreign mc2.exe) — the original blocker (taskkill-all) is removed.
Water.reason: Native Vulkan pass; its GL draw and PipelineDesc were deleted. Vulkan owns the images and pipeline state.
